title: Indian Gas Exchange IPO
summary: Indian Gas Exchange IPO is a book-built issue of 1.67 crore shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Indian Gas Exchange IPO has a total issue size of 1,67,10,000 shares and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Axis Capital Ltd.,, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Indian Gas Exchange financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Indian Gas Exchange Ltd., which was incorporated in 2019, is an authorized exchange offering automated physical delivery for trading of natural gas. The headquarters of the company is in Noida, Uttar Pradesh where the company provides a trading system using its trading system to buy and sell natural gas. As of the 17th July 2026, there are 19 delivery points available for gas traded on this exchange in the five of the six regional gas hubs available in India. · · The company plans to work with financial market organizations to consider how they can develop derivatives based on the gas price benchmark, known as GIXI. They have developed a digital learning platform to create market capabilities for educating people on gas exchange regulations. As of 31st March 2026, there were 46 users who have been able to attend the classes using the platform, and 22 certifications have been issued.
indian Energy Exchange Limited are the company's promoters of Indian Gas Exchange.
